summary: Residential kerb where cars park, but homes 12-13 m away both sides.
reasons: Homes 12-13 m away on both sides

best_section.where: West kerb of Boomerang Road beside the building site, midway along the street

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 12-13 m away on both sides; a building site and garden frontages on the west.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parked cars along both kerbs, so room to stop.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, light local traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the street; No Parking 9am-5pm weekdays and No Stopping signs near the start, outside this section.

flags: Dwellings 10-25 m away on both sides
No Parking 9am-5pm Mon-Fri signs on this kerb
Nearby No Stopping Any Time signs at the south end
sun_shade: Mostly open to sky; scattered street trees give some shade, afternoon sun from the west.
